mn107:1.2: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati pubbārāme migāramātupāsāde.
mn107:1.3: atha kho gaṇakamoggallāno brāhmaṇo yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā bhagavatā saddhiṃ sammodi.
mn107:1.4: sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sārāṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. ekamantaṃ nisinno kho gaṇakamoggallāno brāhmaṇo bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
mn107:2.1: seyyathāpi bho gotama, imassa migāramātu pāsādassa dissati anupubbasikkhā anupubbakiriyā anupubbapaṭipadā, yadidaṃ
mn107:2.3: imesampi hi bho gotama brāhmaṇānaṃ dissati anupubbasikkhā anupubbakiriyā anupubbapaṭipadā, yadidaṃ
mn107:2.5: imesampi hi bho gotama, issāsānaṃ dissati anupubbasikkhā anupubbakiriyā anupubbapaṭipadā yadidaṃ
mn107:2.7: amhākampi hi bho gotama, gaṇakānaṃ gaṇanājīvānaṃ dissati anupubbasikkhā anupubbakiriyā anupubbapaṭipadā, yadidaṃ
mn107:2.9: mayaṃ hi, bho gotama, antevāsī labhitvā paṭhamaṃ evaṃ gaṇāpema:
mn107:2.10: ekaṃ ekakaṃ, dve dukā, tīṇi tikā, cattāri catukkā, pañca pañcakā, cha chakkā, satta sattakā, aṭṭha aṭṭhakā, nava navakā, dasa dasakā’ti;
mn107:2.11: satampi mayaṃ bho gotama, gaṇāpema. bhiyyopi gaṇāpema.
mn107:2.12: sakkā nu kho, bho gotama, imasmimpi dhammavinaye evameva anupubbasikkhā anupubbakiriyā anupubbapaṭipadā paññāpetu’nti.
mn107:3.1: sakkā brāhmaṇa, imasmimpi dhammavinaye anupubbasikkhā anupubbakiriyā anupubbapaṭipadā paññāpetuṃ.
mn107:3.2: seyyathāpi brāhmaṇa, dakkho assadamako bhadraṃ assājānīyaṃ labhitvā paṭhameneva mukhādhāne kāraṇaṃ kāreti. atha uttariṃ kāraṇaṃ kāreti.
mn107:3.3: evameva kho brāhmaṇa, tathāgato purisadammaṃ labhitvā paṭhamaṃ evaṃ vineti:
mn107:3.4: ‘ehi tvaṃ bhikkhu, sīlavā hohi pātimokkhasaṃvarasaṃvuto viharāhi, ācāragocarasampanno, aṇumattesu vajjesu bhayadassāvī, samādāya sikkhassu sikkhāpadesū’ti.
mn107:4.1: yato kho brāhmaṇa, bhikkhu sīlavā hoti, pātimokkhasaṃvarasaṃvuto viharati ācāragocarasampanno aṇumattesu vajjesu bhayadassāvī samādāya sikkhati sikkhāpadesu. tamenaṃ tathāgato uttariṃ vineti:
mn107:4.2: ‘ehi tvaṃ bhikkhu, indriyesu guttadvāro hohi, cakkhunā rūpaṃ disvā mā nimittaggāhī hohi mānubyañjanaggāhī
mn107:4.3: yatvādhikaraṇamenaṃ cakkhundriyaṃ asaṃvutaṃ viharantaṃ abhijjhā domanassā pāpakā akusalā dhammā anvāssaveyyuṃ, tassa saṃvarāya paṭipajjāhi. rakkhāhi cakkhundriyaṃ, cakkhundriye saṃvaraṃ āpajjāhi.
mn107:4.8: manasā dhammaṃ viññāya mā nimittaggāhī hohi mānubyañjanaggāhī.
mn107:4.9: yatvādhikaraṇamenaṃ manindriyaṃ asaṃvutaṃ viharantaṃ abhijjhā domanassā pāpakā akusalā dhammā anvāssaveyyuṃ, tassa saṃvarāya paṭipajjāhi. rakkhāhi manindriyaṃ. manindriye saṃvaraṃ āpajjāhī’ti.
mn107:5.1: yato kho brāhmaṇa, bhikkhu indriyesu guttadvāro hoti. tamenaṃ tathāgato uttariṃ vineti:
mn107:5.4: neva davāya na madāya na maṇḍanāya na vibhūsanāya, yāvadeva imassa kāyassa ṭhitiyā yāpanāya vihiṃsūparatiyā brahmacariyānuggahāya, iti purāṇañca vedanaṃ paṭihaṅkhāmi, navañca vedanaṃ na uppādessāmi, yātrā ca me bhavissati anavajjatā ca phāsuvihāro cā’ti.
mn107:6.1: yato kho brāhmaṇa, bhikkhu bhojane mattaññū hoti. tamenaṃ tathāgato uttariṃ vineti:
mn107:6.2: ‘ehi tvaṃ bhikkhu, jāgariyaṃ anuyutto viharāhi, divasaṃ caṅkamena nisajjāya āvaraṇīyehi dhammehi cittaṃ parisodhehi. rattiyā paṭhamaṃ yāmaṃ caṅkamena nisajjāya āvaraṇīyehi dhammehi cittaṃ parisodhehi, rattiyā majjhimaṃ yāmaṃ dakkhiṇena passena sīhaseyyaṃ kappeyyāsi pāde pādaṃ accādhāya sato sampajāno uṭṭhānasaññaṃ manasikaritvā, rattiyā pacchimaṃ yāmaṃ paccuṭṭhāya caṅkamena nisajjāya āvaraṇīyehi dhammehi cittaṃ parisodhehī’ti.
mn107:7.1: yato kho brāhmaṇa, bhikkhu jāgariyaṃ anuyutto hoti tamenaṃ tathāgato uttariṃ vineti:
mn107:7.2: ‘ehi tvaṃ bhikkhu, satisampajaññena samannāgato hohi, ‘abhikkante paṭikkante sampajānakārī, ālokite vilokite sampajānakārī, samiñjite pasārite sampajānakārī, saṅghāṭipattacīvaradhāraṇe sampajānakārī, asite pīte khāyite sāyite sampajānakārī, uccārapassāvakamme sampajānakārī, gate ṭhite nisinne sutte jāgarite bhāsite tuṇhībhāve sampajānakārī’ti.
mn107:8.1: yato kho brāhmaṇa, bhikkhu satisampajaññena samannāgato hoti. tamenaṃ tathāgato uttariṃ vineti:
mn107:8.2: ‘ehi tvaṃ bhikkhu, vivittaṃ senāsanaṃ bhaja araññaṃ rukkhamūlaṃ pabbataṃ kandaraṃ giriguhaṃ susānaṃ vanapatthaṃ abbhokāsaṃ palālapuñja’nti.
mn107:9.1: so vivittaṃ senāsanaṃ bhajati araññaṃ rukkhamūlaṃ pabbataṃ kandaraṃ giriguhaṃ susānaṃ vanapatthaṃ abbhokāsaṃ palālapuñjaṃ.
mn107:9.2: so pacchābhattaṃ piṇḍapātapaṭikkanto nisīdati pallaṅkaṃ ābhujitvā, ujuṃ kāyaṃ paṇidhāya, parimukhaṃ satiṃ upaṭṭhapetvā,
mn107:9.3: so abhijjhaṃ loke pahāya vigatābhijjhena cetasā viharati. abhijjhāya cittaṃ parisodheti,
mn107:9.4: byāpādapadosaṃ pahāya abyāpannacitto viharati sabbapāṇabhūtahitānukampī, byāpādapadosā cittaṃ parisodheti.
mn107:9.5: thinamiddhaṃ pahāya vigata thinamiddho viharati ālokasaññī sato sampajāno, thinamiddhā cittaṃ parisodheti.
mn107:9.6: uddhaccakukkuccaṃ pahāya anuddhato viharati ajjhattaṃ vūpasantacitto, uddhaccakukkuccā cittaṃ parisodheti.
mn107:9.7: vicikicchaṃ pahāya tiṇṇavicikiccho viharati. akathaṅkathī kusalesu dhammesu. vicikicchāya cittaṃ parisodheti.
mn107:10.1: so ime pañca nīvaraṇe pahāya cetaso upakkilese paññāya dubbalīkaraṇe
mn107:10.2: vivicceva kāmehi vivicca akusalehi dhammehi savitakkaṃ savicāraṃ vivekajaṃ pītisukhaṃ paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati.
mn107:10.3: vitakkavicārānaṃ vūpasamā ajjhattaṃ sampasādanaṃ cetaso ekodibhāvaṃ avitakkaṃ avicāraṃ samādhijaṃ pītisukhaṃ dutiyaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati.
mn107:10.4: pītiyā ca virāgā upekkhako ca viharati sato ca sampajāno sukhaṃca kāyena paṭisaṃvedeti. yaṃ taṃ ariyā ācikkhanti, upekkhako satimā sukhavihārīti. taṃ tatiyaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati.
mn107:10.5: sukhassa ca pahānā dukkhassa ca pahānā pubbeva somanassadomanassānaṃ atthaṅgamā adukkhamasukhaṃ upekkhāsatipārisuddhiṃ catutthaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati.
mn107:11.1: ye kho te brāhmaṇa, bhikkhū sekhā appattamānasā anuttaraṃ yogakkhemaṃ patthayamānā viharanti. tesu me ayaṃ evarūpī anusāsanī hoti:
mn107:11.2: ‘ye pana te bhikkhū arahanto khīṇāsavā vusitavanto katakaraṇīyā ohitabhārā anuppattasadatthā parikkhīṇabhavasaññojanā sammadaññā vimuttā. tesaṃ ime dhammā diṭṭhadhammasukhavihārāya ceva saṃvattanti satisampajaññāya cā’ti.
mn107:12.1: evaṃ vutte gaṇakamoggallāno brāhmaṇo bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
mn107:12.2: ‘kinnu kho bhoto gotamassa sāvakā bhotā gotamena evaṃ ovadīyamānā evaṃ anusāsiyamānā sabbeva accantaniṭṭhaṃ nibbānaṃ ārādhenti, udāhu ekacce nārādhentī’ti?
mn107:12.3: appekacce kho brāhmaṇa, mama sāvakā mayā evaṃ ovadīyamānā evaṃ anusāsiyamānā accantaniṭṭhaṃ nibbānaṃ ārādhenti, ekacce nārādhentī’ti.
mn107:13.1: ko nu kho bho gotama, hetu, ko paccayo, yaṃ tiṭṭhateva nibbānaṃ, tiṭṭhati nibbānagāmimaggo, tiṭṭhati bhavaṃ gotamo samādapetā,
mn107:13.2: atha ca pana bhoto gotamassa sāvakā bhotā gotamena evaṃ ovadiyamānā evaṃ anusāsiyamānā appekacce accantaniṭṭhaṃ nibbānaṃ ārādhenti, ekacce nārādhentī’ti.
mn107:14.1: tena hi brāhmaṇa, taññevettha paṭipucchissāmi. yathā te khameyya, tathā naṃ byākareyyāsi.
mn107:14.4: evaṃ bho, kusalo ahaṃ rājagahagāmissa maggassā’ti.
mn107:14.12: tena muhuttaṃ gaccha, tena muhuttaṃ gantvā dakkhissasi amukaṃ nāma gāmaṃ, tena muhuttaṃ gaccha, tena muhuttaṃ gantvā dakkhissasi amukaṃ nāma nigamaṃ,
mn107:14.13: tena muhuttaṃ gaccha, tena muhuttaṃ gantvā dakkhissasi rājagahassa ārāmarāmaṇeyyakaṃ vanarāmaṇeyyakaṃ bhūmirāmaṇeyyakaṃ pokkharaṇīrāmaṇeyyaka’nti.
mn107:14.14: so tayā evaṃ ovadiyamāno evaṃ anusāsiyamāno ummaggaṃ gahetvā pacchāmukho gaccheyya.
mn107:14.15: atha dutiyo puriso āgaccheyya rājagahaṃ gantukāmo.
mn107:14.20: ehambho purisa, ayaṃ maggo rājagahaṃ gacchati.
mn107:14.21: tena muhuttaṃ gaccha, tena muhuttaṃ gantvā dakkhissasi amukaṃ nāma gāmaṃ,
mn107:14.22: tena muhuttaṃ gaccha, tena muhuttaṃ gantvā dakkhissasi amukaṃ nāma nigamaṃ,
mn107:14.23: tena muhuttaṃ gaccha, tena muhuttaṃ gantvā dakkhissasi rājagahassa ārāmarāmaṇeyyakaṃ vanarāmaṇeyyakaṃ bhūmirāmaṇeyyakaṃ pokkharaṇīrāmaṇeyyaka’nti.
mn107:14.24: so tayā evaṃ ovadiyamāno evaṃ anusāsiyamāno sotthinā rājagahaṃ gaccheyya.
mn107:14.25: ko nu kho brāhmaṇa, hetu, ko paccayo, yaṃ tiṭṭhateva rājagahaṃ, tiṭṭhati rājagahagāmī maggo, tiṭṭhasi tvaṃ samādapetā.
mn107:14.26: atha ca pana tayā evaṃ ovadiyamāno evaṃ anusāsiyamāno eko puriso ummaggaṃ gahetvā pacchāmukho gaccheyya. eko sotthinā rājagahaṃ gaccheyyā’ti?
mn107:14.29: evameva kho brāhmaṇa, tiṭṭhateva nibbānaṃ, tiṭṭhati nibbānagāmimaggo, tiṭṭhāmahaṃ samādapetā,
mn107:14.30: atha ca pana mama sāvakā mayā evaṃ ovadiyamānā evaṃ anusāsiyamānā appekacce accantaniṭṭhaṃ nibbānaṃ ārādhenti, ekacce nārādhenti.
mn107:15.1: evaṃ vutte gaṇakamoggallāno brāhmaṇo bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
mn107:15.2: ‘yeme bho gotama, puggalā assaddhā jīvikatthā agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajitā saṭhā māyāvino keṭubhino uddhatā unnaḷā capalā mukharā vikiṇṇavācā indriyesu aguttadvārā bhojane amattaññuno jāgariyaṃ ananuyuttā sāmaññe anapekkhavanto sikkhāya na tibbagāravā bāhulikā sāthalikā okkamane pubbaṅgamā paviveke nikkhittadhurā kusītā hīnaviriyā muṭṭhassatino asampajānā asamāhitā vibbhantacittā duppaññā eḷamūgā, na tehi bhavaṃ gotamo saddhiṃ saṃvasati.
mn107:15.3: ye paname kulaputtā saddhā agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajitā asaṭhā amāyāvino akeṭubhino anuddhatā anunnaḷā acapalā amukharā avikiṇṇavācā indriyesu guttadvārā bhojane mattaññuno jāgariyaṃ anuyuttā sāmaññe apekkhavanto sikkhāya tibbagāravā na bāhulikā na sāthalikā okkamane nikkhittadhurā paviveke pubbaṅgamā āraddhaviriyā pahitattā upaṭṭhitasatino sampajānā samāhitā ekaggacittā paññavanto aneḷamūgā, tehi bhavaṃ gotamo saddhiṃ saṃvasati.
mn107:16.1: seyyathāpi bho gotama, ye keci mūlagandhā, kālānusārikaṃ tesaṃ aggamakkhāyati.
mn107:16.2: ye keci sāragandhā, lohitacandanaṃ tesaṃ aggamakkhāyati.
mn107:16.3: ye keci pupphagandhā, vassikaṃ tesaṃ aggamakkhāyati.
mn107:16.4: evameva kho bhoto gotamassa ovādo paramajjadhammesu.
mn107:17.2: seyyathāpi bho gotama, nikkujjitaṃ vā ukkujjeyya, paṭicchannaṃ vā vivareyya, mūḷhassa vā maggaṃ ācikkheyya, andhakāre vā telapajjotaṃ dhāreyya cakkhumanto rūpāni dakkhantī’ti. evamevaṃ bhotā gotamena anekapariyāyena dhammo pakāsito.
mn107:17.3: esāhaṃ bhavantaṃ gotamaṃ saraṇaṃ gacchāmi dhammañca bhikkhusaṅghañca.
mn107:17.4: upāsakaṃ maṃ bhavaṃ gotamo dhāretu ajjatagge pāṇupetaṃ saraṇaṃ gatanti.
